native_rule.creator: yugandhar.mocherla@nopalcyber.com
native_rule.description: Detects the use of certutil.exe to download files from remote locations. This technique is commonly used by attackers to download malicious payloads while evading detection by using a trusted Windows utility. The rule monitors process creation events for certutil.exe with command line parameters indicating URL downloads.
native_rule.name: [NopalCyber] Detect File Download via Certutil.exe
native_rule.s1ql: src.process.name = 'certutil.exe' src.process.parent.name='rundll32.exe'(src.process.cmdline contains 'urlcache' OR src.process.cmdline contains '-f') dataSource.category = 'security' dataSource.name in ('SentinelOne', 'Windows Event Logs')
